title: Acute respiratory failure documented but not coded
discharge_summary: SYNTHETIC CASE - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Patient: Synthetic Patient 04, 61-year-old male. MRN: SYN-0004
Reason for admission: Fever, cough, and severe shortness of breath.

On arrival his oxygen saturation was 84% on room air, respiratory rate 32, with use of accessory muscles. Arterial blood gas showed pO2 52 mmHg. He was placed on BiPAP for 24 hours, then weaned to 4 L nasal cannula and to room air by day 4. Chest x-ray showed left lower lobe consolidation, and he was treated with IV ceftriaxone and azithromycin.
Blood glucose was managed with his home basal insulin dose.
2. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure secondary to pneumonia, resolved
Discharge plan: Complete oral antibiotics. Follow up with primary care in 1 week.

expected.notes: The physician clearly documents acute hypoxic respiratory failure, but the code list leaves out J96.01 (MCC). This goes back to coding; no physician query is needed.
